title: One-Pay Futures Prop Plans
summary: Only plans with no activation fee and an end-of-day or static drawdown in both the evaluation and the funded account. One row per account size, lowest to highest.
criteria: One-time payment (monthly-billed plans hidden behind a toggle)
EOD or static drawdown in both evaluation and funded stage
caveats: EOD means the floor only moves up on the closing balance, but every firm still enforces it in real time, so an open loss that touches the floor fails the account.
Sizes, prices and rules change often: confirm at checkout.
Partially verified rows use a third-party read of the firm's site for some figures (e.g. Apex prices from PropBench, LucidFlex per-size figures from third-party reads of lucidtrading.com).
Shark prices shown may include a promo, plus a 5% checkout fee.
PropEd and Blue Guardian billing type was not labelled on their pages.
Rev One: one third-party says it shut in Aug 2026, but its site was live and selling on 11 Nov.
'Not stated' means the firm's page did not show the figure; nothing was estimated.

excluded: Bulenox: $143–$498 activation fee; Option 1 is intraday trailing.
Topstep Standard path: $149 activation (the no-activation path is monthly, behind the toggle).
Take Profit Trader: PRO funded account is intraday trailing, plus $130 PRO fee.
Apex Intraday Trail (all) and EOD Trail standard: intraday drawdown or $109–$159 activation.
TradeDay: Quick Pay funded is always intraday; also monthly.
Goat Funded Futures: Daily Payouts and Instant Classic are intraday when funded; EOD and Flex prices/activation not confirmed on pages read.
Blueberry Accelerated and Funded Futures Family Velocity: intraday trailing.
Shark LITE, Top One Elite Access, FundedHero Hero ONE, IQ Capital Core, Swiss Firmup Classic, Futureify Direct: activation fee or activation not confirmed.
Earn2Trade, Elite Trader Funding, Legends, Leeloo, Purdia, BluSky, Legacy Funded, Lvlup, DayTraders: activation fee.
Winbance (LiveX activation wording conflicts), Savius and Nextproptrader (no prices shown), 18th Street (activation not stated): not confirmed.
Closed or not selling: FundingTicks, TickTick Trader, YRM Prop. Maven has no futures program.
